We need DBE for C11H15NO2. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). For C=11, H=15, N=1, O ignored. DBE = 11 - 15/2 + 1/2 +1 = 11 -7.5 +0.5 +1 = 5.0. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe. Use tool.
